installed_identity.required_evidence: Private installed-artifact readback/identity plus reviewed equivalence to the selected source route; LK3 version string alone is insufficient.

bounded_entry.required_evidence: Reviewed exact route/artifact and limits, actual entry r4/placement, pre-copy extent/overlap and preserved return mechanism; no assumed helper compatibility.

matching_final_dtb.required_evidence: Observed selected post-fixup DTB with candidate driver ABI, effective command line, memory/reservations and CPU contract; raw IDME-bearing capture private.

independent_return.required_evidence: Observed exit after the intended failed experimental load through a mechanism independent of that failed payload; ordinary pre-test stock recovery is insufficient.

failure_log.required_evidence: Fresh attributable failure markers retained across the defined reset/return lifecycle, with truncation/coverage quantified; stock320KiB export alone is insufficient.

next_executable_source_acceptance: Review cached original-route loading/trust alternatives against these five gates; identify one viable nonpersistent bounded entry candidate or rule them out with precise blockers.
privacy: Raw firmware, final DTB/IDME, logs, selectors and identifiers remain private in ignored out; publish normalized allowlisted technical facts only.
